description: Remove the workspace's commerce settings entirely, putting the cart back to never-configured. Only call after the user explicitly confirms. A workspace with orders or carts is refused: report that back to the user and retry with force: true only once they confirm. To change individual settings rather than remove them, use update_cart_config.

force.description: Clear even when the workspace has orders or carts. Without it, a workspace with either is refused and the error names which one is in the way.

name: clear_cart_config
